examples: Bears hibernate when it is cold.
The bear hibernates in a cave.
Some bats hibernate all winter.

more.def: To spend the winter in a deep sleep, as some animals do.
examples: Some frogs hibernate in the mud at the bottom of ponds.
Hedgehogs hibernate in piles of leaves.
Animals that hibernate eat a lot in the fall.

easy.def: To go where no one can see you.
examples: Let's hide behind the couch.
The cat hid under the bed.
I hide from my brother.

more.def: To go or put something where it cannot be seen.
examples: Chameleons hide by changing their colors.
Squirrels hide nuts in the ground for winter.
The twins hid behind the curtain until their mom found them.
The tree is high.
A high shelf.
The mountain is high.

more.def: Reaching a long way up, or at a great distance above the ground.
examples: The giraffe ate leaves from the high branches.
We climbed to a high hill and looked at the town.
The kite flew high above the field.
The bird flew high.
Jump high!
She threw it high.

more.def: To or at a place far above the ground.
examples: Eagles soar high above the canyon.
He jumped as high as he could.
The balloon floated high into the sky.

easy.def: A word for a boy or a man.
examples: I gave him a ball.
Dad is here. Say hi to him.
We saw him at the park.

more.def: A word used for a boy, a man, or a male animal when he is not the one doing the action.
examples: The teacher asked him to carry the books to the library.
Our dog is hungry, so I gave him some food.
Everyone cheered for him when he crossed the finish line.
He hurt himself.
He made lunch himself.
Max sees himself in the mirror.

more.def: Used to talk about a male person who has just been named, as the one who does or gets the action.
examples: He taught himself to play the guitar.
Jake cut himself a slice of bread.
The old farmer built the barn by himself.

easy.def: A word that shows something belongs to a boy or a man.
examples: That is his hat.
His dog is big.
Tom lost his shoe.

more.def: A word used to show that something belongs to or is connected with a boy, a man, or a male animal.
examples: My dad forgot his keys on the kitchen table.
The horse shook his mane in the wind.
Ravi finished his homework before dinner.

easy.def: To touch something hard with a quick move.
examples: I hit the ball.
The ball hit the wall.
She hit the drum.

more.def: To strike something with force, usually with your hand or an object.
examples: She hit the ball over the fence with a bat.
The rain hit the window with a loud tap.
He hit the drum in time with the music.
